title: Smooth Stone One: Vision, Mental Focus, and Overcoming Lockdown Sluggishness
summary: After highlighting First Presidency principles and scientific insights regarding the coronavirus, President Hughes addresses missionary physical health, warning against quarantine weight gain and offering a meal replacement shake along with a practical movement strategy. He then introduces Smooth Stone Number One: Vision and Goals, outlining a four-part framework (What, Why, Sacrifice, When) to build a clear, sensory-rich vision fueled by mental concentration and faith.
